scope: Accettazione materiali: test di infiammabilita' verso l'alto (NHB 8060.16)
description: Il campione acceso non deve sostenere una fiamma che propaga oltre 15 cm.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: To pass the test, the material either resists ignition or, if ignited, must not sustain a flame propagating more than a stated limit (15 cm at present).
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 4]

description: Velocita' nominale dell'aria in cabina tra 8 e 20 cm/s.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: Shut- tle and Space Station Freedom must have air circulation systems to provide a constant flow of air through the cabin; and, as an example, the Shuttle closed- loop air circulation system provides nominal air velocities between 8 and 20 cm/s throughout the crew cabin (Ref.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 7]

scope: Propagazione della fiamma su carta in microgravita'
description: Il massimo rischio di propagazione e' a velocita' di flusso forzato intermedie, nell'intervallo della ventilazione dello Shuttle (8-20 cm/s): li' la fiamma puo' propagare piu' velocemente che in gravita' normale.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: Again, the maxi- mum fire hazard for paper appears to be at intermediate forced-flow velocities attained in low gravity (in the range of current Shuttle ventilation veloci- ties).
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 10]

scope: Infiammabilita' di materiali sottili (carta) in microgravita' con flusso forzato intermedio
description: In microgravita' con flusso intermedio la carta puo' bruciare con O2 fino al 15%, sotto il limite di infiammabilita' misurato in gravita' normale.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: Under these conditions, the material may burn at oxygen concentrations as low as 15 percent, which is below the measured downward-spread flammability limit in normal gravity with no forced convection.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 10]

scope: Atmosfera di riferimento della cabina (aria a livello del mare)
description: Atmosfera di base = aria a livello del mare; concentrazioni superiori rendono i materiali piu' infiammabili. Il valore 21% (20.95%) e' la composizione standard dell'aria: il documento cita 'sea-level air' senza riportare il numero.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: The Shuttle currently uses standard sea-level air as its baseline atmosphere, although an elevated oxygen atmosphere is introduced in preparation for extravehicular activities.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 9]

scope: Volumi non abitati inertizzati (es. armadi elettrici)
description: Un gas inerte che conserva il 6% di O2 puo' essere di fatto sicuro contro l'incendio; il documento non indica un limite superiore oltre il 6%.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: In spacecraft practice, an inert gas retaining 6 percent or greater oxygen concentration may be effec- tively fire-safe.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 12]

description: In orbita il fuoco si e' propagato da un materiale all'altro attraverso uno spazio di 1.3 cm: distanze <= 1.3 cm non impediscono la propagazione.
file_name: NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf
quote: Fires were observed to spread from one material to another over a gap of 1.3 cm.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Fire Safety Applications for Spacecraft NASA.pdf, p. 7]

scope: Protezione termica multistrato (coperta/riparo antincendio NASA Langley)
description: Le coperte termiche multistrato resistono a temperature esterne fino a 2000 °F (1366 K).
quote: The flexible thermal protection systems are multilayer thermal blankets that are designed to handle external temperatures of up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Multilayered Fire Protection System.pdf, p. 1]

description: La cartuccia protegge da un piccolo incendio oppure da 30 000 ppmv (3%) di ammoniaca per oltre 15 minuti.
file_name: NASA_Environmental Control & Life Support_Fire Safety Systems Maturation Team Status.pdf
quote: Protect against either a small-scale fire or 30,000 ppmv (3%) ammonia for >15 min – TDA, Inc.
citation: [Fonte: SAFETY | NASA_Environmental Control & Life Support_Fire Safety Systems Maturation Team Status.pdf, p. 25]
